item.title: Medical interns head to regions
item.description: More than 271 medical interns will head to regional hospitals this year. Those around the Central Highlands include Bendigo Health (43) and Grampians Health (6). Under the guidance of senior doctors, interns rotate through a range of specialties over 47 weeks, including medicine, surgery, emergency, mental health and other clinical areas.
